findings: THE ALLOCATION AS FIRST WRITTEN FORGOT FIVE FIGURES ENTIRELY. IT NAMED SEVEN MALE AND FOUR FEMALE SUBJECTS AND THE PROSE CAME OUT WITH NINE MALE AND SEVEN FEMALE. THE FIVE IT FORGOT WERE THE HUSBAND IN 0606, THE WOMAN THE BAG IS FOR IN 0610, THE WOMAN WHO ASKS A QUESTION IN 0611, THE WOMAN IN THE KITCHEN IN 0612, AND THE MAN IN 0614 WHO DRAWS THE DRAWINGS, TOGETHER WITH THE SECOND FIGURE IN 0613.

THE READ-BACK THEN FOUND ONE GENUINE SAME-GENDER COLLISION THE ALLOCATION COULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT, BECAUSE THE ALLOCATION DID NOT KNOW EITHER FIGURE EXISTED. A WOMAN IN HER EARLY THIRTIES APPEARED IN 0611 AND A WOMAN IN HER EARLY THIRTIES APPEARED IN 0612. THE 0611 FIGURE WAS MOVED TO LATE TWENTIES AND THE PROSE WAS CORRECTED TO MATCH.

THE FINAL POSITION IS NINE DISTINCT MALE BANDS AND SEVEN DISTINCT FEMALE BANDS WITH NO BAND REUSED WITHIN EITHER GENDER AND NO FIGURE GIVEN TWO BANDS INSIDE ONE CHAPTER. THE READ-BACK WAS RUN AGAIN AFTER THE REPAIR AND THE COLLISION COUNT IS NIL.

THE FINDING IS THE THIRD ONE IN THIS REPOSITORY AND IT IS THE SAME ONE AS 0040 AND 0041: AN ALLOCATION WHICH IS NOT READ BACK AGAINST THE PROSE IS NOT A MEASURE. IT HAS NOW FORGOTTEN FIVE FIGURES, WHICH IS THE THIRD WAY IT CAN FAIL.
